problems.title: Item List Manager
problems.description:
Create a React application called 'Item List Manager' that displays a list of items and allows users to add new items to the list. Items should be displayed in an unordered list (`<ul>`).

### Requirements
- When the application loads, it should display an empty list.
- The input field (textbox) should accept user text input.
- When the button is clicked, the text from the input field is added to the list and the input field is cleared.
- If the input field is empty or contains only whitespace, clicking the button should not add anything.
constraints: Input should not add empty or whitespace-only elements.
Render list inside a 'ul' element and items as 'li' elements with 'listitem' role.

problems.title: useArray Custom Hook
problems.description:
Implement a custom React Hook `useArray` that manages dynamic array state modifications with utility helpers.

### Provided Methods
1. `push(item)`: Appends an item to the end of the array.
